`hmac.compare_digest` is the function that avoids content-based short-circuiting. `library/hmac.rst` recommends it over `==` when checking a digest against an externally supplied one, to reduce the vulnerability to timing attacks. `secrets.compare_digest` exposes the same comparison, and `library/secrets.rst` points to `hmac.compare_digest` for details.

I read these from search snippets rather than opening the full pages.
